//: `server` and `web` are excluded for the same reason: they are separate
programs with different `lib`s (Node and the DOM against React Native), and
typechecking one under the other's globals produces failures that are not
bugs. Each has its own `npm run typecheck`.
`web` matters for a second reason that is easy to miss: the bare
`node_modules` entry below only excludes the root one, so without this line
`web/node_modules/@types/react` is pulled into this program alongside the
app's own copy. Two React type packages in one compilation is how a
duplicate-identifier error appears in a file nobody touched.
